## Concrete rule or failed mapping

Link an actual rulebook revision and rule anchor, plus the smallest reproducible example. Describe what happened and what the intended behavior should be.

## Canonical work record

Add or update one `work/semantic/` record using `schema/work-item.schema.json`. Include classification, problem, expected behavior, example, evidence and acceptance criteria. Do not open a speculative semantic task solely because a game lacks formalization.

## Investigation

State whether this is a source-interpretation issue, library/notation issue, implementation bug, adapter limitation or possible semantic gap. Explain any existing construction considered before proposing a new operation.

## Proposed change and review

List changed source/model IDs and exact versions. Include rule/coverage/behavior diffs, affected callers and expected failures. Keep a new release experimental until acceptance and conformance evidence support its declared scope. A passing test is not editorial acceptance.
